statements.text: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.
In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
But we are confident that LCA and HTT-40 will be delivered, and whatever guidance we are giving, 10% to 12%, we'll be able to maintain it.
When we tell 10% to 12%, then hopefully, we have taken all these things into account while we conclude our revenue target for the current financial year.
